summary.tagline: The North Cape (Norwegian: Nordkapp; Northern Sami: Davvenjárga) is a cape on the northern coast of the island

days.title: Plateau Geography and Landmarks
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Nordkapplateau
stops.detail: The rock that the North Cape Plateau is composed of belongs to a metagreywacke-phyllite sequence cropping out over a large area on the island, whose turbiditic source rocks were deposited in the Silurian and whose metamorphosis occurred at the transition from the late Silurian to the early Devonian during the Scandian phase of the Caledonian orogeny.

stops.name: Nordkaphorn
stops.detail: On the eastern flank of the plateau is the rock formation North Cape Horn.

stops.name: Nordkaphalle
stops.detail: The North Cape Hall information center is located on the high plateau of the North Cape.

stops.name: St.-Johannes-Kapelle
stops.detail: In this there is a restaurant, the ecumenical St. John's Chapel, historical exhibitions, souvenir shops, and a post office where you can receive a North Cape diploma stamped with the current date.
